metadata.description: Open-source skills for reading Singapore condo floor plans: measurement, buyer-deterring layout issues, geometry-checked furniture layouts, and sourced renovation rules. Not legal or renovation advice.

plugins.name: sg-floorplan-skills
plugins.description: Three skills: sg-floorplan-analysis (read and measure a plan), sg-space-planning (layout issues, fit-checked layouts, wall type from the plan) and sg-reno-rules (what an owner may change, with verbatim sources).
